description: We are a team of five engineering students with a shared interest in technology, innovation, and problem-solving. We enjoy learning new things, exploring ideas, and working together to make them happen. As five curious minds with different perspectives, we bring our own strengths and a little fun to everything we do. We're excited to be part of the NASA Space Apps Challenge, learn from the experience, and see where our ideas take us! 🚀
summary:
Beyond Their Last Mission: Stories of NASA's Silent Explorers is an educational digital storybook that takes readers on a journey to discover five remarkable pieces of NASA equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars. Through creative storytelling, illustrations, fun facts, and a knowledge quiz, the project introduces the Apollo Lunar Roving Vehicle, Apollo Lunar Surface Experiments Package (ALSEP) and lunar laser reflectors, the Spirit and Opportunity rovers, Sojourner, and Ingenuity.

Each machine tells its own story, explaining its mission, how it worked, where it remains, and the scientific discoveries it helped make possible. The storybook also features a badge-collection concept and a quiz to encourage active learning.

Our goal is to make space science engaging and accessible to young learners while showing that even when a mission ends, its scientific contributions are never forgotten.
details:
Beyond Their Last Mission: Stories of NASA's Silent Explorers is a 17-page illustrated educational digital storybook that explores five remarkable examples of NASA equipment remaining on the Moon and Mars after their missions ended.

The storybook introduces each machine through a first-person storytelling approach, allowing readers to discover its journey from its own perspective. It covers the Apollo Lunar Roving Vehicle, ALSEP science stations and lunar laser reflectors, Spirit and Opportunity, Sojourner, and Ingenuity.

Each section presents mission information, working principles, historical details, fun facts, and scientific contributions. The project also includes a badge-collection concept and a five-question knowledge quiz to encourage active learning and help readers remember what they discover.

We developed the storybook using Canva, with AI tools assisting in the creation and refinement of written content and illustrations. NASA websites and mission resources were consulted for scientific information and references.

Our creative approach combines space exploration, storytelling, visual learning, and quizzes in one educational resource. The project aims to make space science more approachable for young learners while highlighting the lasting scientific value of machines whose missions have ended
